NoSQLServer v0.58 validation
============================

Focus
-----
Correctness repair for Grok Hell Corpus v2 Query 13: recursive CTE cycle guard.

Root causes fixed
-----------------
1. evaluateProjectionExpression now initializes out["ok"] = .false so every
   failure path returns an explicit boolean contract rather than .nil.
2. SQLPredicateParser now supports infix NOT LIKE.
3. SQLPredicateParser now tokenizes and parses || as a shared value-expression
   operator using SQLConcatValueExpression.
4. normalizeValueExpression recognizes SQLConcatValueExpression, so the same
   NOT LIKE/concat predicate works in ordinary SELECT and recursive CTE WHERE.
5. The recursive-only NOT LIKE fallback was removed; recursive WHERE uses the
   ordinary SQLPredicateParser.
6. projectRecursiveRow no longer uses lastPos(" AS ") for alias stripping.
   It uses a top-level AS search so CAST(x AS VARCHAR) is not truncated.
7. executeRecursiveOuter now qualifies CTE rows before ordinary projection,
   matching SQLAliasRelationDefinition's physical-name contract.

Oracle hardening
----------------
Hell Corpus v2 Q13 previously had no oracle. Success therefore fell through to
the scorer's paranoid WRONG_RESULT default. v0.58 adds an independent oracle for
the known employee hierarchy:
  1
  1/2
  1/5
  1/7
  1/8
  1/2/3
  1/2/4
  1/5/6
  1/2/9
  1/7/10

Result
------
Grok Hell Corpus v2:
  PASS            15

  PARSE_ERROR      9
  WRONG_RESULT     0
  EXECUTION_ERROR  0
